title: Saudia Crumble Vegan Parfait
description: A layered dessert featuring saudia, flaky crumble, and rich yogurt, all vegan-friendly.
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together chia seeds and maple syrup. Let it sit for 5 minutes.
In a separate bowl, whisk together vanilla extract and coconut oil.
Layer saudia, crumble, and yogurt in a parfait dish.
Drizzle the chia seed mixture over the yogurt layer.
Drizzle the vanilla-coconut oil mixture over the top layer.
Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes before serving.
Note: You can adjust the amount of chia seeds and maple syrup to your liking.
